mapper.select: select t1.inTaskCount, t2.outTaskCount, t3.inventoryTaskCount, t4.moveTaskCount from (select count(1) inTaskCount from t_advance_delivery where del_flag='0' and create_time>=#{beginDate}) t1, (select count(1) outTaskCount from t_out_delivery where del_flag='0' and create_time>=#{beginDate}) t2, (select count(1) inventoryTaskCount from t_task where del_flag='0' and task_type='3' and create_time>=#{beginDate}) t3, (select count(1) moveTaskCount from t_task where del_flag='0' and task_type='5' and create_time>=#{beginDate}) t4

select t1.notCompleteCount, t2.underwayCount, t3.hasCompleteCount from (select count(1) notCompleteCount from t_advance_delivery where del_flag='0' and complete_state='1') t1, (select count(1) underwayCount from t_advance_delivery where del_flag='0' and complete_state='2') t2, (select count(1) hasCompleteCount from t_advance_delivery where del_flag='0' and complete_state='3') t3

select ad.code, sum(tadd.predict_count) predictCount, sum(tadd.receive_count) receiveCount, ad.create_time createTime, ad.plan_date planDate, ad.predict_date predictDate, (case when ad.plan_date is not null and ad.predict_date is not null then round(ABS(timestampdiff(second,ad.plan_date,ad.predict_date))/3600,1) else null end) time from t_advance_delivery ad left join t_advance_delivery_detail tadd on ad.id=tadd.advance_delivery_id and tadd.del_flag='0' where ad.del_flag='0' and ad.code like concat('%',#{code},'%') group by ad.id order by ad.id desc
